title: iyzitrace · Traffic Flow Atlas
description: Multi-lens visualization of service-to-service and operation-to-operation traffic, derived from iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total. Sankey + heatmap matrix + sunburst + parallel categories make a single hairball into five readable views.

list.name: service
list.label: Client
list.description: Pick a client service. Every flow visualization shows the full reachable subgraph downstream of that service (multi-hop). Pick All for the entire system.

list.name: min_rps
list.label: Min rps (filter)
list.description: Drop edges below this rps to declutter dense graphs.

panels.title: Service edges
panels.description: Distinct (client, server) pairs with traffic in the current range.

panels.title: Failed edge share
panels.description: Share of total request-rate that is marked failed=true.

panels.title: Hottest edge
panels.description: Single highest-traffic (client → server) pair right now.

panels.title: Sankey · client → server
panels.description: Width = rps. Red ribbons = failed edges. The clearest single view of which services drive whom.

targets.expr: sum by (client, server, failed, connection_type, server_type, client_db_system) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])) > ${min_rps}

panels.title: Sankey · client → client_op → server → server_op
panels.description: Four-stage flow. Reading left-to-right: caller service, the exact RPC/HTTP method it issued, the callee service it landed on, and the server-side operation that handled it.

targets.expr: sum by (client, server, client_operation_name, server_operation_name, failed, connection_type, server_type, client_db_system) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])) > ${min_rps}

panels.title: Adjacency matrix · client × server
panels.description: Each cell = traffic from row (client) to column (server). Hover for rps + failed share. Empty cell = no calls.

targets.expr: sum by (client, server) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total{failed="true"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (client, server) (rate(iyzitrace_service_graph_request_total[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Sunburst · connection_type → client → server → server_op
panels.description: Drillable hierarchy of where requests go. Click a ring to zoom. Click center to zoom out.

panels.title: Parallel categories · client → client_type → server
panels.description: Each polyline is a (client, client_type, server) combination, weighted by rps. Drag axis labels to reorder; brush a category to highlight all flows through it. Red = failed.
